summary.tldr: Adds a sentencing factor when someone commits an offence while a place is under evacuation or facing a natural disaster or emergency.
what_it_does: Adds a new aggravating circumstance under the Criminal Code for sentencing when an offender takes advantage of a lawful evacuation order, natural disaster, or other emergency where the offence happened.
summary.background: The bill changes section 718.2 of the Criminal Code, which lists factors courts must consider when deciding a sentence.
